gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-malayala: Impact Label stands up top like beads on a rod, each letter alone, with a high x-height and pincer-like c shapes. And Anek Malayalam follows with a minimal gap between lowercase and caps, so a long passage moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-odia: Impact Label is all commanding weight, every letter standing apart like a bead on a rod. But Anek Odia is the quality that stays with you: its rounds remain unsealed, like an unlatched hook, and its capitals barely rise above the lowercase.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-tamil: Big, round bowls give Anek Tamil a friendly, open look. Over a longer passage those half-unwrapped c and s forms keep the text feeling modern and easy on the eye, while Impact Label above stays heavy and blunt.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-telugu: Pincer-shaped c's and letters set apart like beads on a rod make Impact Label unmistakable. Anek Telugu then carries a longer stretch on wide, tall bowls and unsealed rounds, reading approachable and clean.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anuphan: Impact Label hits hard, each letter standing alone with a high x-height and open pincer-like c shapes. But Anuphan does the quieter job best, with big round bowls and curves left clearly open.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-arimo: Commanding is the mood up top, and Arimo steadies it below. Across a longer passage its tall mean line and spacious gaps in rounded letters keep the text open and unfussy.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-armata: Heavy, blunt letters sit above a spacious sans, with Impact Label commanding attention while Armata keeps its lowercase bodies tall. One shouts, the other leaves room.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-athiti: Approachable Athiti sits under a commanding Impact Label, its s shapes showing a gap you can see through and its mean line set high. The strongest quality is the gap in weight: heavy beads up top, a compass-pencil line below.
